FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Reginald III stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle yet profound transformation is underway.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III, a stout and jovial monarch, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his trusted advisors. The room is filled with the soft glow of candles, but the air is thick with an otherworldly energy.

REGINALD
( stroking his beard )
My friends, I have a vision. A vision of a new era for our great empire. An era of... (pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

ADVISOR 1
(nervously)
Futurism, Your Majesty?

REGINALD
(nodding)
Yes. We shall shed the shackles of tradition and embrace the sleek, the modern, the... (dramatic pause)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE COURTYARD - DAY

The castle courtyard is transformed. Gone are the traditional stone fountains and statues. Instead, a series of retro-futuristic sculptures, reminiscent of 1980s Japanese pop art, stand proudly. A fog machine wafts a misty veil, casting an ethereal glow over the proceedings.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors look on in confusion as the king begins to redecorate the throne room. Gone are the traditional tapestries and suits of armor. Instead, the walls are adorned with vibrant, neon-lit murals depicting futuristic landscapes and abstract patterns.

REGINALD
(excitedly)
Behold! The future of our empire!

ADVISOR 2
(skeptically)
But, Your Majesty... this is not exactly... regal.

REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, but that is where you are wrong, my friend. This is not just a new aesthetic, it is a new way of thinking. A way of embracing the unknown, the uncharted territories of the future.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

As the days pass, the castle walls are transformed. Graffiti tags, reminiscent of 1990s street art, cover the stone surfaces. The tags depict futuristic landscapes, cryptic symbols, and abstract patterns.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors gather around the throne, looking on in awe as the king reveals his latest creation: a massive, holographic display projected onto the ceiling.

REGINALD
(proudly)
Behold! The future of our empire, in all its... (pauses, searching for the right words)...glory.

The hologram flickers to life, displaying a dizzying array of patterns, colors, and shapes. The advisors stare in wonder, unsure what to make of this new, proto-vaporwave aesthetic.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
